description:
Per-source coverage and freshness. Call this first when unsure whether Lexiara holds the law you need — absence of coverage means 'not here', never 'does not exist'.

Pass `work` to ask about ONE instrument. The answer then says which kind of absence it is: `metadata-only` (the instrument is known and no text is held), `language-not-held`, or `not-held`. Each carries `requestable` and a `request_hint` you pass to request_ingestion.

language.description: Optional ISO 639-3 code, e.g. 'fra', to ask about one language version.

work.description: Optional: ask about ONE instrument by CELEX, ELI or official number. The answer then carries `requested.gap` — metadata-only, language-not-held or not-held — or `requested.held: true` when the corpus holds it.

name: get_coverage

outputSchema.description: The JSON response from the corresponding Lexiara API route.

title: What the corpus contains, and how fresh
